hook: Qatar brings Iran's 2-day plan to Trump
reel_hook: Iran's peace plan just got shorter

slides.title: Trump hosts Iran mediator
slides.image_prompt: Two empty leather chairs facing each other across a long wooden table, a sealed envelope in the middle, warm lamp light, dusk through tall windows
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Qatar's PM meets Trump today about Iran's two-day proposal.
WHY IT MATTERS
Qatar is the main go-between in US-Iran talks.
FOR YOU
Trump: more strikes 'highly unlikely' with a deal. Rubio: no progress yet.
slides.body: Qatar's PM meets Trump today about Iran's two-day proposal. Qatar is the main go-between in US-Iran talks. Trump: more strikes 'highly unlikely' with a deal. Rubio: no progress yet.

slides.title: Ukraine peace talks restart
slides.image_prompt: Three empty chairs around a round table in a bright modern hall, three glasses of water, desert city skyline visible through a glass wall
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Russia, Ukraine and the US meet in Abu Dhabi Tue-Wed.
WHY IT MATTERS
First such talks since February, stalled by the war with Iran.
FOR YOU
Kremlin rejects an EU role; Euronews says an EU team will attend.
slides.body: Russia, Ukraine and the US meet in Abu Dhabi Tue-Wed. First such talks since February, stalled by the war with Iran. Kremlin rejects an EU role; Euronews says an EU team will attend.
slides.credit: Clint Ian Pinto (CC BY-SA 4.0) via wikimedia

slides.title: Nvidia probes its own CEO
slides.image_prompt: A computer chip on a dark desk under a large magnifying glass, cold blue light, the long shadow of a keyhole falling across it
slides.label: TECHNOLOGY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Nvidia's board opened an independent probe into CEO Jensen Huang.
WHY IT MATTERS
Reports say a foreign intelligence effort targeted him.
FOR YOU
Nvidia shares dropped about 5% pre-market; Huang admitted an affair and apologised.
slides.body: Nvidia's board opened an independent probe into CEO Jensen Huang. Reports say a foreign intelligence effort targeted him. Nvidia shares dropped about 5% pre-market; Huang admitted an affair and apologised.

slides.title: Eisenkot tasked with coalition
slides.image_prompt: A large semicircle of empty parliament seats in soft morning light, a single wooden gavel resting on a desk in the foreground
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Herzog tasked ex-army chief Gadi Eisenkot with forming a government.
WHY IT MATTERS
Parties holding 67 of 120 seats backed him.
FOR YOU
He has 28 days, plus up to 14; if he fails, likely Netanyahu's turn.
slides.body: Herzog tasked ex-army chief Gadi Eisenkot with forming a government. Parties holding 67 of 120 seats backed him. He has 28 days, plus up to 14; if he fails, likely Netanyahu's turn.
slides.credit: Ana Paula Hirama (CC BY-SA 2.0) via wikimedia

slides.title: NASA is hiring Moon astronauts
slides.image_prompt: An empty white spacesuit helmet resting on grey lunar dust, Earth rising over the horizon in a black starry sky
slides.label: SCIENCE
points: WHAT HAPPENED
NASA is recruiting astronauts who could live on the Moon.
WHY IT MATTERS
NASA aims for a 2028 landing, first since 1972.
FOR YOU
US citizens with a STEM master's, nursing included, can apply until 3 December.
slides.body: NASA is recruiting astronauts who could live on the Moon. NASA aims for a 2028 landing, first since 1972. US citizens with a STEM master's, nursing included, can apply until 3 December.
slides.credit: Neil A. Armstrong (Public domain) via wikimedia

caption:
🕊️ Qatar's PM meets Trump today on Iran's new two-day proposal. Trump calls more strikes 'highly unlikely' with a deal; Rubio says no progress.
🇺🇦 Russia, Ukraine and the US resume talks in Abu Dhabi on 10-11 Nov, the first since February.
💻 Nvidia's board is investigating CEO Jensen Huang. Hold Nvidia or index funds? Shares fell about 5% pre-market.
🇮🇱 Gadi Eisenkot has 28 days to form Israel's next government.
🌕 NASA is hiring astronauts for a future Moon base. US citizens with a STEM master's can apply until 3 December.
